subject: folded umbrella dandy
art_direction: 半收雨伞像披着褶斗篷的矮个角色，弯柄变鼻子，亮蓝褶面配暖粉背景。
composition: one original central subject with a clear silhouette and circular-crop safe focal point
creative_direction: Transform a half-folded umbrella into a short theatrical character. Its pleated canopy becomes a voluminous cobalt cloak, the curved handle a modest hooked nose, and two small feet emerge beneath the folds. One canopy corner lifts like a hand making a restrained greeting. Give the character a narrow amused mouth and small watchful eyes under the top cap. Use painted satin highlights mixed with crisp folded-paper edges on a dusty-pink background. Keep the umbrella closed enough to form one compact silhouette, with no rain scene or human body hidden inside. Square 1024x1024. Keep the complete central silhouette within a circular crop, occupying about 70% of the canvas. Original design; no lettering, logos, or watermark.
style_inspiration: Entirely original text-only concept, no IP characters, copied artwork, celebrity likeness or named artist imitation.
